items.title: Godfrey Hirsch Interview, 1987-10-27
items.q: Johnny Roniga on alto, and Joe Laocana, Erasmus Laocana was on first alto.

ctx.x: Did they have any head arrangements or anything to make a difference? No. The Owls at least had that.

Strictly, there was strictly orchestrations. Seventy-five cents orchestrations, that was the book. Winstein was in that band with you? No. Johnny Roniga, Joe, Joe had a very good first album. The saxophone section was the best section of the band. Johnny Roniga on alto, and Joe Laocana, Erasmus Laocana was on first alto. He was a good, legitimate first alto player.
He sounded good with the Halfway House on the recordings. Yeah. I just heard some this morning.
